cand.title: 2027 CEO Retreat
cand.excerpt: Evidence-backed event and hotel-market fit; accessibility treated conservatively.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Kayla Chandler, CMP, Director of Events: strongest commercial entry point because the 2027 retreat names her for more information and CASP verifies her events role. Lorri Unumb, Esq., Chief Executive Officer: verified executive relationship-development contact; her role makes her a potential strategic sponsor, an inference rather than proof of hotel-contract control. Neither person is publicly established as the hotel-contract signatory.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: January 22–24, 2027, at Sanctuary Cap Cana, Dominican Republic. These are the organizer-published activity dates, not publication dates, and fall within the requested horizon. Registration is restricted to active CASP members and the retreat is intended for the top-level leader of each member organization. No 2028 retreat dates or venue were located; another January cycle is an inference, not a confirmed edition.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: the guestroom-led, leisure-and-peer-networking retreat format fits an all-inclusive resort better than a large convention requirement. Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana offers 620 rooms, three modular meeting rooms totaling 380 m² and outdoor event space; the published retreat agenda uses optional roundtables, collaborative work time and social events. Fit remains conditional on actual guestroom pickup, privacy and meeting requirements, which are unpublished. Its family-friendly Uvero Alto positioning is not equivalent to the announced adult all-inclusive Sanctuary experience. Do not apply the separate CASP conference’s 800-plus attendance to this retreat.
findings.venueCommitments: Sanctuary Cap Cana, a Luxury Collection Resort, Dominican Republic, Adult All-Inclusive is the announced 2027 host hotel. CASP publishes discounted accommodation rates and a December 21, 2026 booking deadline; the agenda names Blue Marlin Palapa II and Castle Island Suite Island. This is specific venue-and-lodging commitment evidence, not generic resort marketing. The signed contract, room-block size, exclusivity and release terms are not public.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified organizer listings: January 26–28, 2024 — El Conquistador Resort, Fajardo, Puerto Rico; January 24–26, 2025 — Loews Ventana Canyon Resort, Tucson, Arizona, USA; January 23–25, 2026 — Hilton Tulum Riviera Maya All-Inclusive Resort, Ciudad Chemuyil, Quintana Roo, Mexico. The confirmed 2027 edition moves to Sanctuary Cap Cana. A participant also reports a 2023 retreat in San Diego with 50 CEOs, but the exact activity dates and hotel are unverified. Consecutive January editions establish recurrence through 2027, not a guaranteed 2028 destination or an open procurement cycle.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 lodging is already arranged at Sanctuary Cap Cana. CASP quotes all-inclusive rates of $539 for a single room and $617 for a double room, with booking link supplied after registration and booking deadline December 21, 2026. The page does not clarify the rate basis sufficiently to normalize it. Attendee booking access is not an open hotel-sourcing RFP. Kayla Chandler is the published event-information contact. No 2027 PCO, DMC, hotel-selection RFP or overflow arrangement was identified. The 2024 retreat named First Class Destination Solutions for airport transfers only; that does not establish a current Dominican Republic appointment or hotel-buying authority.
findings.organizationStructure: CASP is a nonprofit 501(c)(6) trade association of autism service provider organizations, not a hotel, DMC or corporate incentive agency. CASP owns and markets this member-only programme and has an internal Director of Events. Sanctuary Cap Cana is the host hotel, not the event owner. No external 2027 accommodation buyer or PCO was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The 2027 business is assigned to Sanctuary Cap Cana, a competing destination/hotel, not Wyndham Alltra demand. Cap Cana must not be treated as Uvero Alto room demand. The retreat page’s remaining-seat counter is not a room count or evidence of overflow. No 2027 hotel sell-out, overflow request or displacement was found. In 2025, the hotel-accommodation section said SOLD OUT and directed late registrants to the host hotel’s own website subject to availability; that is historical block-pressure evidence only, not off-site overflow demand. The incumbent’s adult all-inclusive positioning creates an experience mismatch to test before pitching a family-friendly alternative.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Kayla Chandler first through CASP’s published event-contact route; acknowledge the January 2027 Sanctuary commitment and ask when the next uncommitted CEO Retreat will be sourced. Request actual historical pickup/peak rooms, delegate and companion counts, room-night pattern, privacy/adults-only requirements, meeting layouts, all-inclusive rate basis, destination shortlist and any appointed planner/DMC. Offer a tailored Uvero Alto executive-retreat proposal only if invited, with private roundtables and social spaces subject to availability. Use Lorri Unumb as a secondary executive relationship contact, not an assumed contracting buyer. Do not claim an active RFP or 2027 overflow opportunity.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low for 2027 hotel capture: named competing host, published CASP rates, registration-linked booking and programmed on-property events. Registration availability does not imply hotel procurement accessibility. No public evidence supports replacement, an additional hotel block or third-party overflow. Relationship outreach is possible, but no Wyndham Alltra room revenue should be attributed to this edition without organizer confirmation.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: rotation across Puerto Rico, Arizona, Mexico and the Dominican Republic creates a credible future resort-bid relationship path. Seek consideration for the next uncommitted retreat rather than attempting to displace 2027. A possible 2028 cycle is not publicly verified and has no established date, destination, room demand or sourcing status. Returning to Punta Cana or accepting Uvero Alto cannot be assumed.
